summary: Stantec Inc. filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing a CEO transition. Gord Johnston will retire as president and CEO effective October 1, 2026, and remain on the board as vice chair. Susan Reisbord, currently COO of North America, has been appointed as the next president and CEO. The transition results from a long-standing board-led succession plan. Ms. Reisbord joined Stantec in 2021 through the acquisition of Cardno, where she was CEO. The filing contains no transaction terms, premiums, or deal mechanics. As a foreign private issuer, this 6-K serves as the equivalent of a U.S. Form 8-K Item 5.02 disclosure for management changes. What to watch: execution of Stantec's next strategic plan under new leadership and continuity of client relationships.
